# Copilot review instructions

When reviewing this repository:

- preserve the product intent in `docs/PRODUCT.md`;
- check canonical-session and architecture boundaries before suggesting abstractions;
- treat privacy, copyright, provenance, resumability, unsupported claims, review burden,
  and authored-vault safety as first-class correctness concerns;
- verify changes stay within the linked goal issue rather than proposing unrelated
  expansion;
- distinguish physical speakers from fictional characters;
- require evidence for consequential claims and benchmark conclusions;
- flag direct-to-`main` workflows or changes that bypass the specialist review loop;
- prefer specific, actionable findings over stylistic churn.
